# THIS IS A SAMPLE PICO2MAPLE CUSTOM CONTROLLER MAPPING CONFIG FILE.
# TO ENABLE YOUR CUSTOM MAPPING, REMOVE "_sameple" FROM THE FILENAME.
# CUSTOM CONTROLLER MAPPINGS WILL ONLY BE LOADED FROM THE FILE "pico2maple_controller_map.cfg"
#
# A mapping config file is a list of mappings, one per line. Hash symbols (#) are used for comments.
# Each line should be in the format: <input>: <output>
# Where <input> is the name of the input button and <output> is the name of the output button.
#
# Available inputs are standard xbox-style gamepad buttons:
#   A, B, X, Y, LB, RB, LT, RT, START
#   A1_UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT, A2_UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT
#   DPAD_UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT
# Available outputs are any Dreamcast controller buttons:
#   A, B, X, Y, LT, RT, START, C, Z, D
#   A1_UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT, A2_UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT
#   DPAD_UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT, DPAD2_UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT
#
# Any input can be mapped to any output.
# Up to 4 inputs can be mapped to the same output e.g. RB and LB both map to B.
#   In the case of multiple inputs mapped to the same output, the value of the output will be determined in an OR fashion.
#   E.g. B will be pressed if either of RB *OR* LB is pressed.
# The same input may be mapped to the multiple outputs e.g. DPAD_UP mapping to A1_UP and DPAD_UP.
#
# Analog LEFT/RIGHT and UP/DOWN will cancel each other out if both are activated.
#
# Standard Dreamcast mapping
A: A
B: B
X: X
Y: Y
LT: LT
RT: RT
START: START
A1_UP: A1_UP
A1_DOWN: A1_DOWN
A1_LEFT: A1_LEFT
A1_RIGHT: A1_RIGHT
DPAD_UP: DPAD_UP
DPAD_DOWN: DPAD_DOWN
DPAD_LEFT: DPAD_LEFT
DPAD_RIGHT: DPAD_RIGHT
# Options: 
#     OPTION_AUTOLOAD: TRUE/FALSE -> tells Pico2Maple whether to use this controller layout on boot
OPTION_AUTOLOAD: TRUE
